content.short: Kodiak is Berachain's native liquidity hub featuring automated concentrated liquidity management and token factory.
content.description:
Kodiak is the definitive, vertically integrated liquidity hub built natively for the Berachain ecosystem. As the only DEX incubated by the "Build-a-Bera" accelerator, the platform brings advanced liquidity management to the network through its "Kodiak Islands"—automated vaults that dynamically optimize concentrated liquidity positions. Additionally, the project features the "Panda Factory," a no-code token deployer that facilitates permissionless token launches for new projects.

Deeply integrated with Berachain's unique Proof of Liquidity (PoL) mechanism, Kodiak allows liquidity providers to earn rewards in the form of BGT (Berachain Governance Token) emissions. The platform serves as a central hub for asset exchange and liquidity bootstrapping, providing users with a seamless and transparent trading experience. By combining automated management with ecosystem-aligned incentives, Kodiak is a cornerstone of the decentralized economy on Berachain, empowering both developers and traders to maximize their capital efficiency.
